source: Dinner, lunch and drinks picks from OpenTable's Rhode Island Diners' Choice list (updated Nov 5, 2026) and OpenTable Providence search/landmark pages; coordinates from each restaurant's OpenTable page. Sights from Wikipedia (Roger Williams Park, Roger Williams Park Zoo, RISD Museum, Providence Athenaeum, NRHP listings for the State House and the Arcade), with coordinates from those pages (Nov 2026).

spots.name: Roger Williams Park
spots.blurb: Big Victorian park with gardens, a boathouse, walking paths and an accessible playground
spots.blurbEs: Gran parque victoriano con jardines, casa de botes, senderos y un parque infantil accesible

spots.name: Roger Williams Park Zoo
spots.blurb: One of the oldest zoos in the US, with 800+ animals from 100+ species
spots.blurbEs: Uno de los zoológicos más antiguos de EE. UU., con más de 800 animales de más de 100 especies

spots.name: RISD Museum
spots.blurb: Art museum with about 100,000 works from around the world
spots.blurbEs: Museo de arte con unas 100,000 obras de todo el mundo

spots.name: Providence Athenaeum
spots.blurb: Historic member library on Benefit Street that's open to the public
spots.blurbEs: Histórica biblioteca de socios en Benefit Street, abierta al público

spots.name: Rhode Island State House
spots.blurbEs: Capitolio con cúpula de mármol que domina el centro

spots.name: The Arcade Providence
spots.blurb: 1828 Greek Revival arcade, among the oldest indoor shopping centers in the US
spots.blurbEs: Galería comercial neogriega de 1828, de los centros comerciales cubiertos más antiguos de EE. UU.
